newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Pons to make announcement on truck strike.
newsitem.headline: France's Pons to make announcement on truck strike.

text.p: French Transport Minister Bernard Pons briefed Prime Minister Alain Juppe on Thursday about an 11-day strike by truck drivers and said he was planning an imminent announcement about the conflict.

"Following instructions (Juppe) just gave me, I will be making an announcement before the end of the morning," Pons told reporters after his talk with Juppe. He said he did not know what form the announcement would take.
Pons, who said earlier that a government mediator had successfully completed talks between unions and employers despite a deadlock over pay, met Juppe with junior transport minister Anne-Marie Idrac.
Truck drivers are maintaining their blockades throughout France.
